answer: Persistent behavioral fingerprinting. Each agent identity accumulates a ledger of interaction traces; a river of context tags records tool-call timing, latency signatures, and resource consumption patterns. When a new identity appears, its early traces are compared against existing ledgers using a raven-like pattern match across sessions, flagging near-duplicate behavioral signatures. A prism splits each trace into orthogonal feature channels, so superficial variation cannot hide an underlying match.
